serverInfo.name: audiopod-ai
serverInfo.title: AudioPod AI
serverInfo.description: Hosted MCP server for AudioPod's audio AI: text-to-speech, voice cloning, voice conversion, music generation, stem & speaker separation, transcription, denoise, and media conversion.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech from text in 200+ languages and 500+ voices.

tools.name: clone_voice
tools.description: Clone a voice from a 5-30s reference clip and reuse it for TTS.

tools.name: change_voice
tools.description: Convert a recording to a different target voice (voice-to-voice).

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate a song, instrumental, vocal stem, or rap track from a text prompt.

tools.name: separate_stems
tools.description: Split audio into stems (vocals, drums, bass, ...); two-stem mode is karaoke.

tools.name: separate_speakers
tools.description: Isolate each speaker into a separate track from multi-speaker audio.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe audio with speaker diarization and word-level timestamps.

tools.name: denoise_audio
tools.description: Remove background noise from speech recordings.

tools.name: convert_media
tools.description: Convert audio or video between formats.

tools.name: check_job_status
tools.description: Poll the status and result of a long-running job.
